en: First UniClipboard Mobile v3 alpha built on the shared Go Engine. Includes cross-device clipboard sync with v2 desktop and CLI peers, local history search, incoming share support, and read-only offline import of previous mobile history. All paired devices must use v2/v3 and establish new pairings.
zh: 基于共享 Go Engine 的首个 UniClipboard 移动端 v3 Alpha 版本。支持与 v2 桌面端及 CLI 跨设备同步剪贴板、本机历史搜索、系统分享导入，以及旧版移动端历史的只读离线迁移。所有配对设备需使用 v2/v3 并重新建立配对。
